name: pre-audit-evidence-check
description: A re-authored defect-dispositions.json for every inherited defect, a closure-claim citation sweep over this cycle's reports, and a classified EGPS red_count — the audit's admissibility inputs, verified before audit runs.
when_to_use: Select when the lane inherits defects from an ancestor cycle (continuation manifest or continuation-registry binding present), or when recent cycles FAILed audit on disposition-preflight, uncited closure claims, or EGPS red_count rather than on code quality.
